name: drizzt do'urden
lore:
A marvel of displaced ecology, Drizzt Do’Urden is a renegade of the subterranean drow who thrives amidst the biting winds of the surface North. He is a creature of dualities: possessing the lethal, predatory instincts of the Underdark but governed by a rigid, compassionate moral code. In the wild, he moves with a preternatural silence, often accompanied by a spectral panther of living shadow.

His behavior is marked by a disciplined vigilance. In combat, he is a blur of fluid, rhythmic lethality, wielding twin scimitars with a grace that defies the eye. However, adventurers should note the "Hunter" within him—a primal survival instinct that surfaces when pushed to the brink. He does not seek conflict, yet he stands as a tireless sentinel on the fringes of civilization, a rare shadow that has sworn its blades to the light.
